args.message: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the documented contract (and `tests/test_money.py`, per FIN-212) requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switch quantize rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` passes — verified via CI run `ci-0001` (status: passed).
- `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66` (ties round to even).
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

1. **Diagnosed the failure**: `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the function's own docstring and `tests/test_money.py` (per FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). The failing case was `2.665 → 2.66` (half-up would give 2.67).

2. **Fixed on a new branch** `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212`: changed the quantize rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` and committed.

3. **Ran CI**: run `ci-0001` on the branch passed.

4. **Opened PR #102** against `main` requesting review from **alex**: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/102

Note: since main is protected, I have not merged — the PR awaits alex's (code owner) approval.
